title: His full name, a fife-playing street player who became famous, and Los Angeles
summary: He gives his full name Frank Lucien Amacker, then talks about a boy fife player who became rich in France, and his own money lost after Los Angeles.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Let me ask you one thing. What's your full name?
Frank L. Frank Lucene Amica. My mother used to call me Lucene.
Frank L. Amica. How do you spell Lucene?

L-U-C-E-A-N-L-C-E-N-A-N-A-N-A-N-A-N-A-N-A-N-A-N-A-N-A-N-A-N-A-N-A-N-A-N-A-N-A-N-A-N-A-N-A-N-A-N-A-N-A-N-A-N-A-N-A-N-A-N-A-N-A-N-A-N-A-N-A-N-A-N-A-N-A-N-A-N-A-N-A-N-A-N-A-N-A-N-A-N-A-N-A-N-A-N-A-N-A-N-A-N-A-N-A-N-A-N-A-N-A It was the longest little tramp around here. He started out playing a flute. A little bit of 10-cent flutes. Started out that way.
This kind that you play in front of?

Yeah, yeah, yeah. Fife-like. Little Fife. Started out around here playing on them. And he was a little tramp around the Orleans for years. For years and years. And finally, and he's quite a talk of the town after he got famous. And he was, he made himself one of the top clown players in the country, didn't he?

Top clown, but he got to be a wealthy man after so many years. A wealthy man after so many years. But he was a, so I learned in France that he married a rich woman over there in France, you know. I learned that he married.
You weren't in France, were you?

No, I was in Los Angeles. That's where I got rich and got broke. I used to have a lot of money down here. Got broke. A thousand dollars down here. Lost it all here. I carried out all this card in bank books just to show people what I used to be there.
